changes.what: New guard 'web' (WEB_REL = 1% of the part's bounding-box diagonal): refuses a flat wall left between two flat-sided cuts, or a cut and the side of the part. New plain sentence. Curved-contact refusals now carry a [curved-near gap=] tag and a sentence that no longer claims 'meet only along an edge or at a point'.
NEW source-level front door: repeatAround/polarPattern with |angle|>=360 (not 360), a non-numeric angle, or options not inline are refused in one sentence.
'web' patch added; --r6 case set; preflight verdict recorded per case; count-truck handles r3-pocket-count-60 with a closed form.
NEW cases, wall sweep (178 cases, guard off and on), wall fuzz (closed form), curved near-gap probe.

Rows rebuilt: 89 rows (was 86). Row 25 now refused; row 76 still wrong (text updated); new rows for thin walls (refused), wide walls/circles/holes/floors (supported), near-touching curved copies (refused with a true sentence); count rows rewritten from the replays.
Live evidence from this round (560 of 566 cases fresh).

defectsResolved.defect: BLOCKING thin web silently dropped (repeat/mirror of pocket, 0.15 mm or less)
defectsResolved.how: Probe: 178 cases, 57 lost with guard off, largest lost wall 0.24% of the diagonal (60x40x10 plate: up to 0.17 mm), 0 lost or wrong with guard on. Kernel loss scales with the part, not a fixed length. Guard refuses up to 1% of the diagonal (0.73 mm on that plate), 4x margin, chosen after seeing the probe (said in the row). Fuzz (closed form, 700 trials x seeds 1,2,3; mirror, repeat, hand-written pockets of other sizes/depths, plate-edge walls, two-axis repeats): guard off 407 wrong (largest wall 0.249% of diagonal), guard on 0 wrong on all three seeds; every trial wrong with guard off is refused with it on. Circles, holes, floors and corner-to-corner pairs were not lost by the kernel (corner pairs refused anyway).
Guarded at the source level (packages/script untouched): refused with one sentence, row now 'refused'; 360 and omitted angle unaffected.

defectsResolved.defect: False sentence 'meet only along an edge or at a point' for curved copies a hair apart
defectsResolved.how: New sentence says the copies lie too close to tell whether they touch; pm-gap-probe.json (20 pairs, gaps 1e-6..5 mm) shows spheres refused up to 1e-3 mm, cylinders up to 3e-4, the rest built within the curved bar.

Replayed one at a time under the 1500M cap: r3-pocket-count-40 and r3-hole-count-60 fully with OCCT (pass); r3-box-count-1000, r3-box-count-1001, r3-box-count-1e5, r3-around-count-1001, r3-pocket-count-60, r3-around-count-360 truck-alone (OCCT oracle does not fit the cap) with closed forms/sentences. The pocket-count row moved from unsupported to supported; around-360 is a refusal after ~490 s.

defectsOpen.defect: Row 76 (partial angle spaced angle/(count-1) for pocket/hole but angle/count for whole shapes)
defectsOpen.why: Language defect in packages/script, which may not be edited. A source guard would also refuse partial pocket/hole turns that match FreeCAD, losing a measured feature. Kept WRONG and labelled; the whole-shape side is already refused by the translator.

defectsOpen.defect: Minor: curved bar 3e-4 cannot see a lost lens/sliver on curved copies
defectsOpen.why: Oracle limit (tessellated volume). Not changed; no tolerance was loosened.

defectsOpen.defect: Minor: row 58 time-budget sentence shown with a 3 s demo limit
defectsOpen.why: No suite case reaches 600 s; r3-around-count-360 takes ~490 s and is refused for another reason.
Walls to non-box part outlines, between cuts from different axes (slanted), or to bosses/join seams are not covered or not measured; stated in the row.
